newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Bromine raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bromine raised to buy.

text.p: Sahar Securities and Investments upgraded Dead Sea Bromine Ltd to a buy from a hold after the Israeli company reported better-than-expected second quarter results.
Bromine posted net income of 39 million shekels, up from 30 million a year earlier and against Sahar's forecast of 27 million.

"The improvement in the results is mainly attributable to an upturn in the bromine and bromine compounds markets as well as to the company's significant streamlining efforts," Sahar analyst Boaz Leviatan said in report released on Tuesday.
"The rebound in the bromine market was fueled by a recovery in the PC industry (a user of fire retardant intermediate products)," the report said.
Sahar set a 12-month price target of 28 to 30 shekels for the shares, which on Tuesday stood at 25.2 shekels.
